items.title: Anthropic embeds Accenture as independent evaluator
items.body: Anthropic announces partnership with Accenture (via Faculty) for independent evaluation of frontier AI, including red-teaming, alignment assessments and safeguard testing. Both parties plan at least $1bn investment each over five years. This operationalises Dario Amodei’s earlier call to embed evaluators inside labs with employee-level access.

items.title: xAI releases Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0
items.body: SpaceXAI ships Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0, ranking first on Artificial Analysis streaming leaderboard among 32 models and doubling accuracy of 1.0 at identical price ($0.10/h batch, $0.20/h streaming). Built on Grok Voice audio foundation; already powering Atlassian Loom.

items.title: OpenAI publishes Australian Youth Safety Blueprint
items.body: OpenAI releases a six-pillar roadmap for youth AI safety in Australia, covering literacy, age-appropriate safeguards, privacy-protective age assurance and parental controls. Follows August rollout of ChatGPT for Teens in Australia.
